Call for Q2 FY27  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Company will hold Q2 FY27 Earnings

L&T Technology Services (LTTS) will announce its results for the Second Quarter of FY27 (ending September 
30, 2026) on Monday, October 19, 2026, after Indian stock market trading hours. The results will be available 
on www.LTTS.com.
Following the results announcement, the company will host an Earnings conference call at 17:30 hrs IST, 
during which the leadership team will discuss results and take questions.
Note: The audio of the Earnings Call will be available for replay, one hour after the end of the call, on
